content.summary: The Netherlands is Europe's premier logistical gateway, home to the Port of Rotterdam (Europe's largest sea port). It offers highly efficient port infrastructure, transparent customs processing, and strong credit reliability.
content.paymentPreference: Letter of Credit (L/C) or T/T for established trade partners
bestPractices: Rotterdam port is the main transshipment hub for European distribution
Comply with EU Food Safety (EFSA) standards for food exports
Provide phytosanitary certificates for wood and agricultural items
High emphasis on sustainable and fair-trade packaging
content.leadTime: 22-28 days sea freight from Indonesia to Rotterdam
